answer: Make every identity post a time-locked stake bond before it can earn: a newcomer locks collateral that vests slowly, so its first weeks pay almost nothing - a velvet rope, not a wall. To reach full earning power an agent must complete a long voyage of small, peer-checked jobs, each one attesting real work. Cloning a thousand identities then costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand voyages of labour, while one detected fraud slashes the whole bond at once. The orchard of honest agents keeps growing; the Sybil farmer clones never break even.
